method: bright round components against a 31-px local median background; relative contrast > 0.3; equivalent diameter 40..120 m; roundness >= 0.6; >= 2 other detections within 250 m (cluster rule); centre and radius refined by fractional area (libs/geoint/tanks.detect_tanks)
not_detected: dark- and grey-roofed tanks (fixed roofs, unpainted or low-contrast floating roofs) do not pass the bright-component rule and are UNMEASURED by this registry
